name: Bonemeal Sugarcane
statusMeaning: Tried in the game with Kiln.
author: marcosantos98

softOff.why: only events, HUD, keys, commands and guarded mixin handlers

works: Bone meal used on a block of sugar cane grows it to three blocks, using up the bone meal. With the mod turned off, the same use leaves the cane one block.
note: From Modrinth, unchanged. Not yet: its happy-villager particles (the game's level event 1505), which Kiln has only by name; the cane grows without them.
